skills.name: Common-denominator fraction subtraction
skills.definition: Subtract fractional parts with a shared denominator by subtracting numerators and keeping the denominator.

skills.name: Find and use a common denominator
skills.definition: Find an LCD or other common denominator for unlike denominators and convert fraction parts to equivalent fractions.

skills.name: Mixed/whole part decomposition
skills.definition: Represent mixed numbers and whole numbers as separate whole and fractional parts, subtract whole parts, and recombine the result.

skills.name: Borrow across the whole-fraction boundary
skills.definition: Regroup one or more wholes as denominator-over-denominator fractional units when the fractional subtraction would otherwise be negative.

skills.name: Simplify final fractional form
skills.definition: Express the final fractional result in acceptable simplest form by reducing common factors or converting a zero fractional part to an integer.
